critical_code_review_comments: MainframePage.jsx defines helper formatTimeAgo AFTER using it inside fetchData via useCallback. It works because JS function hoisting via `const formatTimeAgo = (dateString) => ...` is NOT hoisted, but fetchData captures it at call time (runtime). Currently formatTimeAgo is called inside the callback body which runs after render, so it works, but placing formatTimeAgo above fetchData would be cleaner and avoid TDZ-adjacent confusion. Also formatTimeAgo is not listed in fetchData's useCallback deps.
MainframePage uses supabase.auth.getSession() (good) - unified with AppLayout now, resolving iteration_1's dual-pattern comment for THIS file.
Opportunities data is set via a client-side hardcoded zero object inside fetchData (lines 454-461). Once /api/opportunities exists, this should be replaced. Currently correctly shows zeros per spec.

Projects status mapping in MainframePage (lines 441-444) buckets many statuses together (e.g. pending/planned -> starting_soon, active -> in_progress). Verify this matches backend project status enum to avoid mis-categorization when real data lands.

Recent Activity 'time' formatting relies on backend field created_at + client formatTimeAgo. Works but the timeline currently shows 'No recent activity' because /api/tfcs/activity returns []. Not a bug; just note that activity logging endpoints exist but no events have been logged yet.
Two console 404 errors on initial load (not on /app/mainframe itself) - should be located and removed.
